svg.title: Agreement among physicians
svg.desc: Two upper triangular matrices report exact pairwise agreement and Cohen's kappa for four physicians in breast cancer and PDAC. Color redundantly encodes kappa.

ns2:Work.dc:title: Agreement among physicians
ns2:Work.dc:description: Two upper triangular matrices report exact pairwise agreement and Cohen's kappa for four physicians in breast cancer and PDAC. Color redundantly encodes kappa.
